  "type": "file",
  "content": "# Dummy RCA Payment App\n\nThis is a small Spring Boot Java application intended as a target for root-cause-analysis exercises. It exposes simple payment endpoints and a couple of endpoints that intentionally produce errors/slowdowns so an RCA utility can analyze logs and traces.\n\nQuick run\n\nPrerequisites: Java 17+, Maven\n\nRun with:\n\n```bash\nmvn spring-boot:run\n```\n\nEndpoints\n\n- POST /api/payments — create a payment (JSON body: `{\"amount\": 12.34, \"currency\": \"USD\"}`)\n- GET /api/payments — list payments\n- GET /api/payments/{id} — get a payment\n- GET /api/incidents/nullpointer — triggers a NullPointerException (for RCA)\n- GET /api/incidents/timeout — simulates a long-running operation (~5s) (for RCA)\n\nLogs and analysis\n\nThe application logs key events (payment.created) and will print stack traces for unhandled exceptions. Use these logs and endpoints to create incidents for your RCA tooling.\n\nProject files of interest\n\n- `pom.xml` — Maven config\n- `src/main/java/com/example/dummyrca` — application sources\n- `src/main/resources/logback-spring.xml` — logging\na dummy repository for the RCA Agent Github MCP testing",

  "content": "package com.example.dummyrca.gateway;\n\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.Payment;\nimport org.slf4j.Logger;\nimport org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;\nimport org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Component;\n\nimport java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException;\nimport java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;\n\n/**\n * Faulty gateway simulating a misconfiguration: `gateway.timeout` is documented\n * in seconds but this client mistakenly treats the value as milliseconds.\n * That makes the effective timeout extremely small and causes frequent\n * TimeoutExceptions during normal processing.\n */\n@Component\npublic class FaultyPaymentGatewayClient implements PaymentGatewayClient {\n    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(FaultyPaymentGatewayClient.class);\n\n    // configured value is intended to be seconds but the client treats it as ms\n    @Value(\"${gateway.timeout:2}\")\n    private int configuredTimeout;\n\n    @Override\n    public void process(Payment payment) throws TimeoutException {\n        int timeoutInterpretedAsMs = configuredTimeout; // bug: should multiply by 1000\n\n        int processingMs = ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(200, 800);\n        log.info(\"gateway.process id={} configured={} (interpreted ms) processing={}ms\",\n                payment.getId(), configuredTimeout, processingMs);\n\n        try {\n            Thread.sleep(processingMs);\n        } catch (InterruptedException e) {\n            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();\n            throw new RuntimeException(\"interrupted\", e);\n        }\n\n        if (processingMs > timeoutInterpretedAsMs) {\n            throw new TimeoutException(\"Gateway timed out after \" + timeoutInterpretedAsMs + \"ms (configured value interpreted as ms)\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n",

  "content": "package com.example.dummyrca.service;\n\nimport com.example.dummyrca.exception.PaymentNotFoundException;\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.Payment;\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.PaymentRequest;\n\nimport org.slf4j.Logger;\nimport org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal;\nimport java.time.Instant;\nimport java.util.*;\n\n@Service\npublic class PaymentService {\n    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PaymentService.class);\n\n    private final Map<UUID, Payment> store = Collections.synchronizedMap(new LinkedHashMap<>());\n\n    public Payment createPayment(PaymentRequest req) {\n        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();\n        Payment p = new Payment(id, req.getAmount() == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO : req.getAmount(),\n                req.getCurrency() == null ? \"USD\" : req.getCurrency(), \"CREATED\", Instant.now());\n        store.put(id, p);\n        log.info(\"payment.created id={} amount={} currency={}\", id, p.getAmount(), p.getCurrency());\n        return p;\n    }\n\n    public List<Payment> listPayments() {\n        return new ArrayList<>(store.values());\n    }\n\n    public Payment getPayment(UUID id) {\n        Payment p = store.get(id);\n        if (p == null) throw new PaymentNotFoundException(\"Payment \" + id + \" not found\");\n        return p;\n    }\n\n    // method to intentionally cause a NullPointerException for RCA examples\n    public void simulateNullPointer() {\n        log.info(\"Simulating NullPointerException\");\n        String s = null;\n        s.length();\n    }\n\n    // method to intentionally simulate a timeout-like long operation\n    public void simulateTimeout() {\n        log.info(\"Simulating long processing (5s)\");\n        try {\n            Thread.sleep(5000);\n        } catch (InterruptedException e) {\n            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();\n        }\n    }\n}\n",

  "type": "file",
  "content": "# Dummy RCA Payment App\n\nThis is a small Spring Boot Java application intended as a target for root-cause-analysis exercises. It exposes simple payment endpoints and a couple of endpoints that intentionally produce errors/slowdowns so an RCA utility can analyze logs and traces.\n\nQuick run\n\nPrerequisites: Java 17+, Maven\n\nRun with:\n\n```bash\nmvn spring-boot:run\n```\n\nEndpoints\n\n- POST /api/payments — create a payment (JSON body: `{\"amount\": 12.34, \"currency\": \"USD\"}`)\n- GET /api/payments — list payments\n- GET /api/payments/{id} — get a payment\n- GET /api/incidents/nullpointer — triggers a NullPointerException (for RCA)\n- GET /api/incidents/timeout — simulates a long-running operation (~5s) (for RCA)\n\nLogs and analysis\n\nThe application logs key events (payment.created) and will print stack traces for unhandled exceptions. Use these logs and endpoints to create incidents for your RCA tooling.\n\nProject files of interest\n\n- `pom.xml` — Maven config\n- `src/main/java/com/example/dummyrca` — application sources\n- `src/main/resources/logback-spring.xml` — logging\na dummy repository for the RCA Agent Github MCP testing",

  "content": "package com.example.dummyrca.exception;\n\nimport org.slf4j.Logger;\nimport org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;\nimport org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;\nimport org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;\n\nimport java.time.Instant;\nimport java.util.HashMap;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n@RestControllerAdvice\npublic class RestExceptionHandler {\n    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RestExceptionHandler.class);\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(PaymentNotFoundException.class)\n    public ResponseEntity<?> handleNotFound(PaymentNotFoundException ex) {\n        log.warn(\"Payment not found: {}\", ex.getMessage());\n        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();\n        body.put(\"timestamp\", Instant.now().toString());\n        body.put(\"message\", ex.getMessage());\n        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND).body(body);\n    }\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)\n    public ResponseEntity<?> handleGeneric(Exception ex) {\n        log.error(\"Unhandled exception: {}\", ex.toString(), ex);\n        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();\n        body.put(\"timestamp\", Instant.now().toString());\n        body.put(\"message\", \"internal_error\");\n        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).body(body);\n    }\n}\n",

  "content": "package com.example.dummyrca.gateway;\n\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.Payment;\nimport org.slf4j.Logger;\nimport org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;\nimport org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Component;\n\nimport java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException;\nimport java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;\n\n/**\n * Faulty gateway simulating a misconfiguration: `gateway.timeout` is documented\n * in seconds but this client mistakenly treats the value as milliseconds.\n * That makes the effective timeout extremely small and causes frequent\n * TimeoutExceptions during normal processing.\n */\n@Component\npublic class FaultyPaymentGatewayClient implements PaymentGatewayClient {\n    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(FaultyPaymentGatewayClient.class);\n\n    // configured value is intended to be seconds but the client treats it as ms\n    @Value(\"${gateway.timeout:2}\")\n    private int configuredTimeout;\n\n    @Override\n    public void process(Payment payment) throws TimeoutException {\n        int timeoutInterpretedAsMs = configuredTimeout; // bug: should multiply by 1000\n\n        int processingMs = ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(200, 800);\n        log.info(\"gateway.process id={} configured={} (interpreted ms) processing={}ms\",\n                payment.getId(), configuredTimeout, processingMs);\n\n        try {\n            Thread.sleep(processingMs);\n        } catch (InterruptedException e) {\n            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();\n            throw new RuntimeException(\"interrupted\", e);\n        }\n\n        if (processingMs > timeoutInterpretedAsMs) {\n            throw new TimeoutException(\"Gateway timed out after \" + timeoutInterpretedAsMs + \"ms (configured value interpreted as ms)\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n",

  "content": "package com.example.dummyrca.controller;\n\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.Payment;\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.PaymentRequest;\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.PaymentResponse;\nimport com.example.dummyrca.service.PaymentService;\n\nimport org.slf4j.Logger;\nimport org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;\nimport org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.UUID;\nimport java.util.stream.Collectors;\n\n@RestController\n@RequestMapping(\"/api\")\npublic class PaymentController {\n    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PaymentController.class);\n    private final PaymentService paymentService;\n\n    public PaymentController(PaymentService paymentService) {\n        this.paymentService = paymentService;\n    }\n\n    @PostMapping(\"/payments\")\n    public ResponseEntity<PaymentResponse> create(@RequestBody PaymentRequest req) {\n        Payment p = paymentService.createPayment(req);\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(new PaymentResponse(p.getId(), p.getStatus(), p.getCreatedAt()));\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/payments\")\n    public ResponseEntity<List<PaymentResponse>> list() {\n        List<PaymentResponse> out = paymentService.listPayments().stream()\n                .map(p -> new PaymentResponse(p.getId(), p.getStatus(), p.getCreatedAt()))\n                .collect(Collectors.toList());\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(out);\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/payments/{id}\")\n    public ResponseEntity<Payment> get(@PathVariable String id) {\n        UUID uuid = UUID.fromString(id);\n        Payment p = paymentService.getPayment(uuid);\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(p);\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/incidents/nullpointer\")\n    public ResponseEntity<String> causeNpe() {\n        paymentService.simulateNullPointer();\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(\"should not reach\");\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/incidents/timeout\")\n    public ResponseEntity<String> causeTimeout() {\n        paymentService.simulateTimeout();\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(\"done\");\n    }\n}\n",

  "content": "package com.example.dummyrca.controller;\n\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.Payment;\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.PaymentRequest;\nimport org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.UUID;\nimport java.util.stream.Collectors;\n\n@RestController\n@RequestMapping(\"/api\")\npublic class PaymentController {\n    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PaymentController.class);\n    private final PaymentService paymentService;\n\n    public PaymentController(PaymentService paymentService) {\n        this.paymentService = paymentService;\n    }\n\n    @PostMapping(\"/payments\")\n    public ResponseEntity<PaymentResponse> create(@RequestBody PaymentRequest req) {\n        Payment p = paymentService.createPayment(req);\n        return List<PaymentResponse> out = paymentService.listPayments().stream()\n                .map(p -> new PaymentResponse(p.getId(), p.getStatus(), p.getCreatedAt()))\n                .collect(Collectors.toList());\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(out);\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/payments/{id}\")\n    public ResponseEntity<Payment> get(@PathVariable String id) {\n        UUID   "content": "# Dummy RCA Payment App\n\nThis is a small Spring Boot Java application intended as a target for root-cause-analysis exercises. It exposes simple payment endpoints and a couple of endpoints that intentionally produce errors/slowdowns so an RCA utility can analyze logs and traces.\n\nQuick run\n\nPrerequisites: Java 17+, Maven\n\nRun with:\n\n```bash\nmvn spring-boot:run\n```\n\nEndpoints\n\n- POST /api/payments — create a payment (JSON body: `{\"amount\": 12.34, \"currency\": \"USD\"}`)\n- GET /api/payments — list payments\n- GET /api/payments/{id} — get a payment\n- GET /api/incidents/nullpointer — triggers a NullPointerException (for RCA)\n- GET /api/incidents/timeout — simulates a long-running operation (~5s) (for RCA)\n\nLogs and analysis\n\nThe application logs key events (payment.created) and will print stack traces for unhandled exceptions. Use these logs and endpoints to create incidents for your RCA tooling.\n\nProject files of interest\n\n- `pom.xml` — Maven config\n- `src/main/java/com/example/dummyrca` — application sources\n- `src/main/resources/logback-spring.xml` — logging\na dummy repository for the RCA Agent Github MCP testing",

{
  "summary": "The last repository commit introduced and wired a gateway client that deterministically converts the intended gateway timeout from seconds to milliseconds. With no repository-defined gateway.timeout property, the client defaults to 2 but treats it as 2 ms; its simulated gateway processing always takes 200–799 ms, so payment submissions time out after deployment.",
  "root_cause": "Commit 0f0b9c8367f6555ddab604addc11d8c3c8dbc26c added FaultyPaymentGatewayClient with a timeout-unit conversion defect: gateway.timeout is intended to be seconds, but configuredTimeout is used directly as milliseconds instead of being multiplied by 1000. The default value of 2 therefore becomes an effective 2 ms timeout. Since gateway processing is deliberately 200–799 ms, every normal payment gateway call exceeds that timeout and throws TimeoutException; PaymentService catches it and marks the transaction TIMEOUT.",

  "content": "package com.example.dummyrca.controller;\n\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.Payment;\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.PaymentRequest;\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.PaymentResponse;\nimport com.example.dummyrca.service.PaymentService;\n\nimport org.slf4j.Logger;\nimport org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;\nimport org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.UUID;\nimport java.util.stream.Collectors;\n\n@RestController\n@RequestMapping(\"/api\")\npublic class PaymentController {\n    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PaymentController.class);\n    private final PaymentService paymentService;\n\n    public PaymentController(PaymentService paymentService) {\n        this.paymentService = paymentService;\n    }\n\n    @PostMapping(\"/payments\")\n    public ResponseEntity<PaymentResponse> create(@RequestBody PaymentRequest req) {\n        Payment p = paymentService.createPayment(req);\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(new PaymentResponse(p.getId(), p.getStatus(), p.getCreatedAt()));\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/payments\")\n    public ResponseEntity<List<PaymentResponse>> list() {\n        List<PaymentResponse> out = paymentService.listPayments().stream()\n                .map(p -> new PaymentResponse(p.getId(), p.getStatus(), p.getCreatedAt()))\n                .collect(Collectors.toList());\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(out);\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/payments/{id}\")\n    public ResponseEntity<Payment> get(@PathVariable String id) {\n        UUID uuid = UUID.fromString(id);\n        Payment p = paymentService.getPayment(uuid);\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(p);\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/incidents/nullpointer\")\n    public ResponseEntity<String> causeNpe() {\n        paymentService.simulateNullPointer();\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(\"should not reach\");\n    }\n\n    @GetMapping(\"/incidents/timeout\")\n    public ResponseEntity<String> causeTimeout() {\n        paymentService.simulateTimeout();\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(\"done\");\n    }\n}\n",

  "content": "package com.example.dummyrca.exception;\n\nimport org.slf4j.Logger;\nimport org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;\nimport org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;\nimport org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;\n\nimport java.time.Instant;\nimport java.util.HashMap;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n@RestControllerAdvice\npublic class RestExceptionHandler {\n    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RestExceptionHandler.class);\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(PaymentNotFoundException.class)\n    public ResponseEntity<?> handleNotFound(PaymentNotFoundException ex) {\n        log.warn(\"Payment not found: {}\", ex.getMessage());\n        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();\n        body.put(\"timestamp\", Instant.now().toString());\n        body.put(\"message\", ex.getMessage());\n        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND).body(body);\n    }\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)\n    public ResponseEntity<?> handleGeneric(Exception ex) {\n        log.error(\"Unhandled exception: {}\", ex.toString(), ex);\n        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();\n        body.put(\"timestamp\", Instant.now().toString());\n        body.put(\"message\", \"internal_error\");\n        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).body(body);\n    }\n}\n",

  "type": "file",
  "content": "package com.example.dummyrca.gateway;\n\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.Payment;\nimport org.slf4j.Logger;\nimport org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;\nimport org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Component;\n\nimport java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException;\nimport java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;\n\n/**\n * Faulty gateway simulating a misconfiguration: `gateway.timeout` is documented\n * in seconds but this client mistakenly treats the value as milliseconds.\n * That makes the effective timeout extremely small and causes frequent\n * TimeoutExceptions during normal processing.\n */\n@Component\npublic class FaultyPaymentGatewayClient implements PaymentGatewayClient {\n    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(FaultyPaymentGatewayClient.class);\n\n    // configured value is intended to be seconds but the client treats it as ms\n    @Value(\"${gateway.timeout:2}\")\n    private int configuredTimeout;\n\n    @Override\n    public void process(Payment payment) throws TimeoutException {\n        int timeoutInterpretedAsMs = configuredTimeout; // bug: should multiply by 1000\n\n        int processingMs = ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(200, 800);\n        log.info(\"gateway.process id={} configured={} (interpreted ms) processing={}ms\",\n                payment.getId(), configuredTimeout, processingMs);\n\n        try {\n            Thread.sleep(processingMs);\n        } catch (InterruptedException e) {\n            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();\n            throw new RuntimeException(\"interrupted\", e);\n        }\n\n        if (processingMs > timeoutInterpretedAsMs) {\n            throw new TimeoutException(\"Gateway timed out after \" + timeoutInterpretedAsMs + \"ms (configured value interpreted as ms)\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n",

  "type": "file",
  "content": "# Dummy RCA Payment App\n\nThis is a small Spring Boot Java application intended as a target for root-cause-analysis exercises. It exposes simple payment endpoints and a couple of endpoints that intentionally produce errors/slowdowns so an RCA utility can analyze logs and traces.\n\nQuick run\n\nPrerequisites: Java 17+, Maven\n\nRun with:\n\n```bash\nmvn spring-boot:run\n```\n\nEndpoints\n\n- POST /api/payments — create a payment (JSON body: `{\"amount\": 12.34, \"currency\": \"USD\"}`)\n- GET /api/payments — list payments\n- GET /api/payments/{id} — get a payment\n- GET /api/incidents/nullpointer — triggers a NullPointerException (for RCA)\n- GET /api/incidents/timeout — simulates a long-running operation (~5s) (for RCA)\n\nLogs and analysis\n\nThe application logs key events (payment.created) and will print stack traces for unhandled exceptions. Use these logs and endpoints to create incidents for your RCA tooling.\n\nProject files of interest\n\n- `pom.xml` — Maven config\n- `src/main/java/com/example/dummyrca` — application sources\n- `src/main/resources/logback-spring.xml` — logging\na dummy repository for the RCA Agent Github MCP testing",

  "content": "# Dummy RCA Payment App\n\nThis is a small Spring Boot Java application intended as a target for root-cause-analysis exercises.   "content": "package com.example.dummyrca.gateway;\n\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.Payment;\nimport org.slf4j.Logger;\nimport org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;\nimport org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Component;\n\nimport java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException;\nimport java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;\n\n/**\n * Faulty gateway simulating a misconfiguration: `gateway.timeout` is documented\n * in seconds but this client mistakenly treats the value as milliseconds.\n * That makes the effective timeout extremely small and causes frequent\n * TimeoutExceptions during normal processing.\n */\n@Component\npublic class FaultyPaymentGatewayClient implements PaymentGatewayClient {\n    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(FaultyPaymentGatewayClient.class);\n\n    // configured value is intended to be seconds but the client treats it as ms\n    @Value(\"${gateway.timeout:2}\")\n    private int configuredTimeout;\n\n    @Override\n    public void process(Payment payment) throws TimeoutException {\n        int timeoutInterpretedAsMs = configuredTimeout; // bug: should multiply by 1000\n\n        int processingMs = ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(200, 800);\n        log.info(\"gateway.process id={} configured={} (interpreted ms) processing={}ms\",\n                payment.getId(), configuredTimeout, processingMs);\n\n        try {\n            Thread.sleep(processingMs);\n        } catch (InterruptedException e) {\n            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();\n            throw new RuntimeException(\"interrupted\", e);\n        }\n\n        if (processingMs > timeoutInterpretedAsMs) {\n            throw new TimeoutException(\"Gateway timed out after \" + timeoutInterpretedAsMs + \"ms (configured value interpreted as ms)\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n",

org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.UUID;\nimport java.util.stream.Collectors;\n\n@RestController\n@RequestMapping(\"/api\")\npublic class PaymentController {\n    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PaymentController.class);\n    private final PaymentService paymentService;\n\n    public PaymentController(PaymentService paymentService) {\n        this.paymentService = paymentService;\n    }\n\n    @PostMapping(\"/payments\")\n    public ResponseEntity<PaymentResponse> create(@RequestBody PaymentRequest req) {\n        Payment p = paymentService.createPayment(req);\n        return org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.UUID;\nimport java.util.stream.Collectors;\n\n@RestController\n@RequestMapping(\"/api\")\npublic class PaymentController {\n    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PaymentController.class);\n    private final PaymentService paymentService;\n\n    public PaymentController(PaymentService paymentService) {\n        this.paymentService = paymentService;\n    }\n\n    @PostMapping(\"/payments\")\n    public ResponseEntity<PaymentResponse> create(@RequestBody PaymentRequest req) {\n        Payment p = paymentService.createPayment(req);\n        return   "type": "file",
  "content": "package com.example.dummyrca.gateway;\n\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.Payment;\nimport org.slf4j.Logger;\nimport org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;\nimport org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Component;\n\nimport java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException;\nimport java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;\n\n/**\n * Faulty gateway simulating a misconfiguration: `gateway.timeout` is documented\n * in seconds but this client mistakenly treats the value as milliseconds.\n * That makes the effective timeout extremely small and causes frequent\n * TimeoutExceptions during normal processing.\n */\n@Component\npublic class FaultyPaymentGatewayClient implements PaymentGatewayClient {\n    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(FaultyPaymentGatewayClient.class);\n\n    // configured value is intended to be seconds but the client treats it as ms\n    @Value(\"${gateway.timeout:2}\")\n    private int configuredTimeout;\n\n    @Override\n    public void process(Payment payment) throws TimeoutException {\n        int timeoutInterpretedAsMs = configuredTimeout; // bug: should multiply by 1000\n\n        int processingMs = ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(200, 800);\n        log.info(\"gateway.process id={} configured={} (interpreted ms) processing={}ms\",\n                payment.getId(), configuredTimeout, processingMs);\n\n        try {\n            Thread.sleep(processingMs);\n        } catch (InterruptedException e) {\n            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();\n            throw new RuntimeException(\"interrupted\", e);\n        }\n\n        if (processingMs > timeoutInterpretedAsMs) {\n            throw new TimeoutException(\"Gateway timed out after \" + timeoutInterpretedAsMs + \"ms (configured value interpreted as ms)\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n",

  "type": "file",
  "content": "package com.example.dummyrca.exception;\n\nimport org.slf4j.Logger;\nimport org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;\nimport org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;\nimport org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;\n\nimport java.time.Instant;\nimport java.util.HashMap;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n@RestControllerAdvice\npublic class RestExceptionHandler {\n    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RestExceptionHandler.class);\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(PaymentNotFoundException.class)\n    public ResponseEntity<?> handleNotFound(PaymentNotFoundException ex) {\n        log.warn(\"Payment not found: {}\", ex.getMessage());\n        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();\n        body.put(\"timestamp\", Instant.now().toString());\n        body.put(\"message\", ex.getMessage());\n        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND).body(body);\n    }\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)\n    public ResponseEntity<?> handleGeneric(Exception ex) {\n        log.error(\"Unhandled exception: {}\", ex.toString(), ex);\n        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();\n        body.put(\"timestamp\", Instant.now().toString());\n        body.put(\"message\", \"internal_error\");\n        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).body(body);\n    }\n}\n",

  "download_url": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Krishna-2992/Dummy_RCA_Payment_app/0f0b9c8367f6555ddab604addc11d8c3c8dbc26c/readme.md",
  "type": "file",
  "content": "# Dummy RCA Payment App\n\nThis is a small Spring Boot Java application intended as a target for root-cause-analysis exercises. It exposes simple payment endpoints and a couple of endpoints that intentionally produce errors/slowdowns so an RCA utility can analyze logs and traces.\n\nQuick run\n\nPrerequisites: Java 17+, Maven\n\nRun with:\n\n```bash\nmvn spring-boot:run\n```\n\nEndpoints\n\n- POST /api/payments — create a payment (JSON body: `{\"amount\": 12.34, \"currency\": \"USD\"}`)\n- GET /api/payments — list payments\n- GET /api/payments/{id} — get a payment\n- GET /api/incidents/nullpointer — triggers a NullPointerException (for RCA)\n- GET /api/incidents/timeout — simulates a long-running operation (~5s) (for RCA)\n\nLogs and analysis\n\nThe application logs key events (payment.created) and will print stack traces for unhandled exceptions. Use these logs and endpoints to create incidents for your RCA tooling.\n\nProject files of interest\n\n- `pom.xml` — Maven config\n- `src/main/java/com/example/dummyrca` — application sources\n- `src/main/resources/logback-spring.xml` — logging\na dummy repository for the RCA Agent Github MCP testing",

  "content": "package com.example.dummyrca.config;\n\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.PaymentRequest;\nimport com.example.dummyrca.service.PaymentService;\nimport org.slf4j.Logger;\nimport org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;\nimport org.springframework.boot.CommandLineRunner;\nimport org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;\nimport org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal;\n\n@Configuration\npublic class DataLoader {\n    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DataLoader.class);\n\n    @Bean\n    CommandLineRunner seed(PaymentService paymentService) {\n        return args -> {\n            log.info(\"Seeding sample payments\");\n            PaymentRequest r1 = new PaymentRequest();\n            r1.setAmount(new BigDecimal(\"12.34\"));\n            r1.setCurrency(\"USD\");\n            paymentService.createPayment(r1);\n\n            PaymentRequest r2 = new PaymentRequest();\n            r2.setAmount(new BigDecimal(\"99.99\"));\n            r2.setCurrency(\"EUR\");\n            paymentService.createPayment(r2);\n        };\n    }\n}\n",

  "type": "file",
  "content": "package com.example.dummyrca.service;\n\nimport com.example.dummyrca.exception.PaymentNotFoundException;\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.Payment;\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.PaymentRequest;\n\nimport org.slf4j.Logger;\nimport org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal;\nimport java.time.Instant;\nimport java.util.*;\n\n@Service\npublic class PaymentService {\n    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PaymentService.class);\n\n    private final Map<UUID, Payment> store = Collections.synchronizedMap(new LinkedHashMap<>());\n\n    public Payment createPayment(PaymentRequest req) {\n        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();\n        Payment p = new Payment(id, req.getAmount() == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO : req.getAmount(),\n                req.getCurrency() == null ? \"USD\" : req.getCurrency(), \"CREATED\", Instant.now());\n        store.put(id, p);\n        log.info(\"payment.created id={} amount={} currency={}\", id, p.getAmount(), p.getCurrency());\n        return p;\n    }\n\n    public List<Payment> listPayments() {\n        return new ArrayList<>(store.values());\n    }\n\n    public Payment getPayment(UUID id) {\n        Payment p = store.get(id);\n        if (p == null) throw new PaymentNotFoundException(\"Payment \" + id + \" not found\");\n        return p;\n    }\n\n    // method to intentionally cause a NullPointerException for RCA examples\n    public void simulateNullPointer() {\n        log.info(\"Simulating NullPointerException\");\n        String s = null;\n        s.length();\n    }\n\n    // method to intentionally simulate a timeout-like long operation\n    public void simulateTimeout() {\n        log.info(\"Simulating long processing (5s)\");\n        try {\n            Thread.sleep(5000);\n        } catch (InterruptedException e) {\n            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();\n        }\n    }\n}\n",

This change was introduced in the most recent commit, aligning with the post-deployment onset.",

  "type": "file",
  "content": "# Dummy RCA Payment App\n\nThis is a small Spring Boot Java application intended as a target for root-cause-analysis exercises. It exposes simple payment endpoints and a couple of endpoints that intentionally produce errors/slowdowns so an RCA utility can analyze logs and traces.\n\nQuick run\n\nPrerequisites: Java 17+, Maven\n\nRun with:\n\n```bash\nmvn spring-boot:run\n```\n\nEndpoints\n\n- POST /api/payments — create a payment (JSON body: `{\"amount\": 12.34, \"currency\": \"USD\"}`)\n- GET /api/payments — list payments\n- GET /api/payments/{id} — get a payment\n- GET /api/incidents/nullpointer — triggers a NullPointerException (for RCA)\n- GET /api/incidents/timeout — simulates a long-running operation (~5s) (for RCA)\n\nLogs and analysis\n\nThe application logs key events (payment.created) and will print stack traces for unhandled exceptions. Use these logs and endpoints to create incidents for your RCA tooling.\n\nProject files of interest\n\n- `pom.xml` — Maven config\n- `src/main/java/com/example/dummyrca` — application sources\n- `src/main/resources/logback-spring.xml` — logging\na dummy repository for the RCA Agent Github MCP testing",

  "download_url": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Krishna-2992/Dummy_RCA_Payment_app/0f0b9c8367f6555ddab604addc11d8c3c8dbc26c/src/main/java/com/example/dummyrca/gateway/FaultyPaymentGatewayClient.java",
  "type": "file",
  "content": "package com.example.dummyrca.gateway;\n\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.Payment;\nimport org.slf4j.Logger;\nimport org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;\nimport org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Component;\n\nimport java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException;\nimport java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;\n\n/**\n * Faulty gateway simulating a misconfiguration: `gateway.timeout` is documented\n * in seconds but this client mistakenly treats the value as milliseconds.\n * That makes the effective timeout extremely small and causes frequent\n * TimeoutExceptions during normal processing.\n */\n@Component\npublic class FaultyPaymentGatewayClient implements PaymentGatewayClient {\n    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(FaultyPaymentGatewayClient.class);\n\n    // configured value is intended to be seconds but the client treats it as ms\n    @Value(\"${gateway.timeout:2}\")\n    private int configuredTimeout;\n\n    @Override\n    public void process(Payment payment) throws TimeoutException {\n        int timeoutInterpretedAsMs = configuredTimeout; // bug: should multiply by 1000\n\n        int processingMs = ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(200, 800);\n        log.info(\"gateway.process id={} configured={} (interpreted ms) processing={}ms\",\n                payment.getId(), configuredTimeout, processingMs);\n\n        try {\n            Thread.sleep(processingMs);\n        } catch (InterruptedException e) {\n            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();\n            throw new RuntimeException(\"interrupted\", e);\n        }\n\n        if (processingMs > timeoutInterpretedAsMs) {\n            throw new TimeoutException(\"Gateway timed out after \" + timeoutInterpretedAsMs + \"ms (configured value interpreted as ms)\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n",

  "content": "package com.example.dummyrca.service;\n\nimport com.example.dummyrca.exception.PaymentNotFoundException;\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.Payment;\nimport com.example.dummyrca.model.PaymentRequest;\n\nimport org.slf4j.Logger;\nimport org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal;\nimport java.time.Instant;\nimport java.util.*;\n\n@Service\npublic class PaymentService {\n    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PaymentService.class);\n\n    private final Map<UUID, Payment> store = Collections.synchronizedMap(new LinkedHashMap<>());\n\n    public Payment createPayment(PaymentRequest req) {\n        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();\n        Payment p = new Payment(id, req.getAmount() == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO : req.getAmount(),\n                req.getCurrency() == null ? \"USD\" : req.getCurrency(), \"CREATED\", Instant.now());\n        store.put(id, p);\n        log.info(\"payment.created id={} amount={} currency={}\", id, p.getAmount(), p.getCurrency());\n        return p;\n    }\n\n    public List<Payment> listPayments() {\n        return new ArrayList<>(store.values());\n    }\n\n    public Payment getPayment(UUID id) {\n        Payment p = store.get(id);\n        if (p == null) throw new PaymentNotFoundException(\"Payment \" + id + \" not found\");\n        return p;\n    }\n\n    // method to intentionally cause a NullPointerException for RCA examples\n    public void simulateNullPointer() {\n        log.info(\"Simulating NullPointerException\");\n        String s = null;\n        s.length();\n    }\n\n    // method to intentionally simulate a timeout-like long operation\n    public void simulateTimeout() {\n        log.info(\"Simulating long processing (5s)\");\n        try {\n            Thread.sleep(5000);\n        } catch (InterruptedException e) {\n            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();\n        }\n    }\n}\n",

  "summary": "The last repository commit introduced a PaymentGatewayClient implementation that deterministically misinterprets the gateway timeout unit. New payment creation now invokes this client; with the repository default of 2, ordinary simulated gateway processing (200-799 ms) exceeds an effective 2 ms timeout and is recorded as TIMEOUT. The prior revision created payments locally and had no gateway invocation. No pull requests or GitHub issues exist in the repository.",
  "root_cause": "Commit 0f0b9c8367f6555ddab604addc11d8c3c8dbc26c introduced FaultyPaymentGatewayClient, which reads gateway.timeout as a value intended to represent seconds but uses it directly as milliseconds instead of multiplying by 1000. Because application.properties does not set gateway.timeout, the @Value default of 2 applies, producing a 2 ms effective timeout. The client deliberately sleeps for 200-799 ms and throws TimeoutException whenever processing exceeds that threshold; therefore every normal payment gateway call times out. PaymentService catches that exception and sets the transaction status to TIMEOUT.",

  "limitations": [

    "No production logs, metrics, traces, or request samples were available to quantify the observed failure rate.",
    "The gateway client is a simulated implementation, so the repository does not provide evidence about an actual external payment provider's behavior."
